screenRemoval20261014.policy: The October 14 approved removal supersedes earlier presentation requirements for the 39 retired screens. Do not rebuild draft comparison/management/discard screens, context or coupled-setting approval gates, technical attachment/storage/renderer repair screens, billing/checkout/credit receipts, extra retry confirmation, or the retired result notices. Unfinished work is reached through conversation history. Retry is a direct deliberate action with a new execution identity; uncertain acceptance still reconciles the original identity. Data retention, conflict detection, media ownership, idempotency and internal recovery remain required. The retirement record, not older screenshots or state-model labels, determines active UI scope.
screenRemoval20261014.historicalValidation: Earlier complete-coverage and prototype validation claims predate the approved removal; retired references are not active UI acceptance evidence.

screenRemoval20261015.policy: The October 15 removal deleted screens and components that drew backend or contract states as UI: the auth state machine, cancellation races, request reconciliation, cross-tab submission and guest-draft ownership. Do not redraw them. Their behavior stays in backend contracts and tests; only the requirement for a dedicated UI surface is retired. The real client surfaces are AuthGateDialog "Sign in to continue", the RequireAuth redirect to /signin, the AccountPopover and toasts.

screenRemoval20261015b.policy: The second October 15 pass deleted screens, state variants and status components whose only purpose was to show a backend or contract state or to restate an invariant as a screen (cancellation races, reconciliation, provider status, storage and metadata internals, capability-rule demos, lane and ownership assertions, upload/download/profile outcome screens). Do not redraw them; their behavior stays in backend contracts and tests. Real surfaces: AuthGateDialog "Sign in to continue", RequireAuth redirect to /signin, the AccountPopover, inline messages and toasts.

screenRemoval20261016.policy: The October 16 auth redesign rebuilt every sign-in, account-creation, recovery and verification screen on one Auth card (Conversation panel material) over the Ambient backdrop. Sign in and Create account switch in place and share one size; account creation has a single password field with Show, so the confirm-password mismatch screens are retired. Do not redraw them; a typo is caught by Show and by the reset flow.

screenRemoval20261016b.policy: The October 16 auth state pass kept one screen per step and one example of each card state: A01 sign in, A14 create account, A03 field error, A04 request-error notice, A05 busy, A21 check your email, A23 resend countdown, A24 checking a link, A25 email verified, A26 verification link expired, A31 forgot password, A34 check your inbox, A37 choose a new password, A41 password changed and A42 reset link expired, with their N twins (N08, N10, N70, N09, N44, N12, N81, N50, N51, N13, N14, N15, N16, N17, N90). The other 39 desktop screens and their 39 mobile twins repeated one of these with different words, showed a form with text typed in, or drew a state that cannot happen. Do not redraw them. A request error uses A04's notice with its own message; a field problem uses A03's Field error; a submit in progress uses A05's busy button. The Check verification action and its three result screens were removed everywhere (A21, A23, K26-K28 and their mobile twins): opening the emailed link verifies the address, and nothing waits on verification. Kept submit buttons now open the next step: A01 to A05, A14 to A21, A31 to A34, A37 to A41 (mobile N08 to N44, N10 to N12, N14 to N15, N16 to N17).

screenRemoval20261016c.policy: The October 16 account state pass kept one screen per step and one example of each card state in Account & usage: K01 profile, K02 profile awaiting verification, K27 verification resent with its countdown, K04 edit display name, K22 field error, K08 password and sign-in settings, K24 busy, K10 reset requested, K25 request-error notice, K09 Google sign-in settings, K11 usage, K12 allowance used, K16 no usage history, K13 usage loading, K14 usage could not load, K17 data and privacy and K18 the sign-out guard, with their mobile twins (N23, N98, N127, N100, N122, N24, N124, N105, N125, N104, N25, N106, N110, N107, N108, N27, N36). K03 and K29 drew the Profile panel loading and failing on its own, which cannot happen because the profile comes with the signed-in session (X02 and X03 cover a page that is loading or failed). K26 and K28 repeated K24's busy button and K25's notice. K23 asked the person to confirm their own Cancel of a one-field name edit. Do not redraw them. K04's Cancel and account links now open K01, K08, K11, K17 and K18 directly; N98's Resend verification opens N127 and N100's Cancel opens N23.
